---
title: "Tutorials Overview"
lang: en-US
---

This section contains the tutorials for `SimilaritySearchEngine.jl`, the embedded engine. The [server tutorial](../server/tutorial.qmd) presents the same operations over HTTP, through the service layer built on the engine.

- **[Getting Started](getting-started.qmd)**: a sequence of examples over the paragraphs of Mary Shelley's *Frankenstein*. It covers:
  - Dense vector similarity search using LSI-derived embeddings with `SearchGraph`.
  - Sparse vector indexing with `InvertedFile`.
  - Full-text retrieval with BM25 and TF-IDF models.
  - Logical soft deletions and metadata filtering.
  - Target recall calibration via `calibrate!`.
  - Transactional persistence (closing and reopening projects).
  - Whole-dataset metric operations (`allknn`, `fft`, `closestpairs`, `bichromatic_kclosestpairs`).

- **[Multilingual Paragraph Search](paragraph-search.qmd)**: indexing of corpora in three languages: the English, Spanish and Portuguese collections of Project Gutenberg, and English Wikipedia. It covers:
  - Fitting and configuring linguistic profiles (`TextProfile`).
  - Orthographic query variant resolution and semantic query expansion.
  - Measurements of indexing rate, memory use, and search latency.

After the model of the engine is known, the [server manual](../server/manual.qmd) describes the
translation it performs: one endpoint per call, one status code per error category, and one job
per operation over an entire dataset.
